verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Watchlist reports that check an applicant's records against sanctions, PEP, monitored-list and adverse-media watchlists. These run on the same applicant/report model and API as the Document and Facial Similarity checks, with workflows orchestrated in Workflow Studio and results delivered by webhook or polling. missing for 10: explicit evidence that watchlist checks are configured as a step inside the same verification workflow, documentation of a unified dashboard surface for reviewing watchlist hits alongside other results, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
